description: Peer-reviewed bibliographic chronology table for Nordic & Baltic prehistoric rock art (Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Karelia/White Sea). Distinguishes radiocarbon (14C) excavation dates, post-glacial isostatic shoreline displacement curves, stratigraphic superposition, and typological-stylistic metalwork correlation. Unverified DOIs/ISBNs are explicitly null; lab codes are never fabricated.

sources.title: Helleristningene i Alta: spor etter ritualer og dagligliv i Finnmarks forhistorie
sources.notes: Foundational five-phase shoreline-displacement chronology for Alta rock art (Hjemmeluft, Kåfjord, Amtmannsnes, Storsteinen, Transfarelv).

sources.title: Communicating with the World of Beings: The World Heritage Rock Art Sites in Alta, Arctic Norway
sources.notes: Updated calibrated shoreline chronology for Alta Phases 1-5 (~5200-200 BCE, ~26.5 m to ~8.5 m a.s.l.).

sources.title: Concepts of rock in Late Mesolithic western Norway
sources.booktitle: Changing Pictures: Rock Art Traditions and Visions in Northern Europe
sources.notes: Excavation and radiocarbon dating of Late Mesolithic cultural layers and dwelling features associated with Vingen rock art (~5000-4000 cal BCE).

sources.title: The method and physical processes behind the making of hunters' rock art in Western Norway: the experimental production of images
sources.booktitle: Small Things Remembered: Early Farmers and Rock Art
sources.notes: Refines Late Mesolithic 14C chronology (~4900-4000 cal BCE) and stratigraphic evidence for Vingen.

sources.title: Monumental Art of Northern Sweden from the Stone Age: Nämforsen and Other Localities
sources.notes: Corpus documentation of Nämforsen panels across Brådön, Notön, and Laxön.

sources.title: En kronologisk analys av ristningarna vid Nämforsen
sources.booktitle: Ekonomi och näringsformer i nordisk bronsålder
sources.notes: Chronological seriation of Nämforsen hunter-gatherer (Late Mesolithic/Neolithic) and agrarian Bronze Age ship motifs (~4200-500 BCE).

sources.title: Rock Art and Landscapes: Studies of Stone Age Rock Art from Northern Fennoscandia
sources.notes: Pan-Fennoscandian shoreline-displacement synthesis for Alta, Leiknes/Valle, Nämforsen, Kanozero, Lake Onega, and Vyg/Zalavruga.

sources.title: Elevated Rock Art: Towards a Maritime Understanding of Bronze Age Rock Art in Northern Bohuslän, Sweden
sources.notes: Shoreline displacement calibration of Bohuslän/Tanum panels (~16-10 m a.s.l.) tied to Montelius Periods I-VI (~1700-500 BCE) and Pre-Roman Iron Age.

sources.title: Elevated Rock Art: Towards a Maritime Understanding of Bronze Age Rock Art in Northern Bohuslän, Sweden (revised / 2nd ed.)
sources.notes: Refines shoreline elevation curves and Montelius Period I-VI ship chronology across Bohuslän.

sources.title: Østfolds helleristninger
sources.notes: Shoreline displacement and typological synthesis of Østfold Bronze Age carvings (~1700-500 BCE, 17-10 m a.s.l.).

sources.title: Prehistoric Imagery and Landscapes: Rock Art in Stjørdal, Trøndelag, Norway
sources.notes: Shoreline and typological chronology for Stjørdal and Trøndelag rock art (Stone Age hunter-gatherer vs Bronze Age agrarian Leirfall/Hegre/Bardal).

sources.title: Gutorm Gjessing og helleristningene i Trøndelag / Rock art and shoreline displacement in Mid-Norway
sources.notes: Refines Trøndelag hunter-gatherer shoreline phases (Bøla, Evenhus, Strand, Hell, Holtås, Bardal) vs Bronze Age panels.

sources.title: Arktiske helleristninger i Nord-Norge
sources.publisher: Aschehoug (Instituttet for sammenlignende kulturforskning Serie B XXI)
sources.notes: Foundational Arctic rock-art corpus for Leiknes, Valle, Fykanvatnet, Forselv, Skjomen, and Rødøy.

sources.title: Nordenfjelske ristninger og malinger av den arktiske gruppe
sources.publisher: Aschehoug (Instituttet for sammenlignende kulturforskning Serie B XXX)
sources.notes: Corpus and stylistic-stratigraphic study of Trøndelag Arctic carvings and paintings (including Bardal superposition).

sources.title: Bredarör on Kivik: a monumental cairn and the history of its interpretation
sources.notes: AMS radiocarbon dating of human osteological remains from the Kivik cist placing the primary burial and cist slabs in Montelius Period II-III (~1400-1100 cal BCE).

sources.title: Bredarör på Kivik — en arkeologisk odyssé
sources.notes: Comprehensive monograph synthesizing Bredarör/Kivik 14C dates (~1400-1100 cal BCE) and Bronze Age burial context.

sources.title: A Chorological Study of North European Rock Art
sources.notes: Chorological and typological classification of South Scandinavian Bronze Age carvings (~1700-500 BCE).

sources.title: Ships on Bronzes: A Study in Bronze Age Religion and Iconography
sources.notes: Ship-prow typology anchored to dated bronze razors and metalwork across Montelius Periods I-VI (~1700-500 BCE).

sources.title: A Touch of Red: Archaeological and Ethnographic Approaches to Interpreting Finnish Rock Paintings
sources.notes: Shoreline/lake-level displacement (Ancient Saimaa/Päijänne) and excavation chronology of Finnish red-ochre rock paintings (~5000-1500 BCE).

sources.title: The hunters' rock art in northern Norway: Problems of chronology and interpretation
sources.notes: Shoreline displacement chronology placing polished Nordland hunter-gatherer carvings (Leiknes/Valle) in the Early/Middle Mesolithic (~9000-6000 BCE).
